method: Haversine nearest sensor from the existing 68 verified 2024/2025 sensor coordinates; Earth radius 6371000 m; raw distance <= 500 m; ties choose lowest numeric sensor ID; stored distance rounded to 0.1 m.
measurement_scope: Estimated nearby street passages per minute per metre; original hourly means also shown. Not station occupancy, waiting passengers or onboard load.
spatial_caveat: Straight-line proximity does not establish pedestrian access or which side of a road/barrier the passenger uses. Rail uses existing merged station reference points, not every station entrance. No new station or sensor is added.
bus_rule: Original 49 bus-sensor links remain unchanged; 5 displayed bus stops without original links remain unmapped.
time_rule: Reuse exact heat sensor profile values, pooling valid dates in 2024 and 2025 for matching month, daily weather, day type and hour; missing is not zero; valid zero is retained.
